profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Full Stack .NET, C#, React, Angular | AI-Native: LLMs, Agentic Workflows, MCP
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience building and shipping software across multiple stacks, from enterprise financial platforms to cloud analytics, e-commerce, and video games. I specialize in turning complex problems into reliable, maintainable systems, and I'm actively evolving my craft to thrive in the AI-augmented era of software development.
I've worked extensively with C#, .NET, C/C++, TypeScript, Angular, React, PHP, and Android, for clients including Microsoft, Comcast Business, General Electric, and Becton Dickinson. Beyond writing code, I bring strong systems thinking, deep GNU/Linux expertise (20+ years), and a practical approach to ownership and delivery.
As an AI-native engineer, I design agentic workflows with Claude Code, custom Skills, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, applying prompt and context engineering to generate code, tests, and reviews faster without sacrificing engineering rigor.
I also create technical content in Spanish and contribute to open source.
→ Website: benyhdez.com
→ GitHub: github.com/BenyHdezM
Open to opportunities where I can combine solid engineering fundamentals with modern AI-assisted development practices.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
In my daily workflow I operate as an AI-native engineer. I design and use advanced agentic workflows, custom Skills, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to give LLMs deep, structured access to our internal tools, repositories, and documentation. I apply sophisticated prompt engineering, context engineering, tool calling, and evaluation techniques to generate high-quality code, automated tests, reviews, and refactors across a large multi-repo enterprise codebase. This approach has significantly accelerated feature delivery and improved the reliability of business-critical financial modules.
Key Skills
Full-stack development: React, .NET microservices, gRPC, Apigee API Gateway
Production debugging & support of high-stakes financial/accounting systems
Docker, Kubernetes, Tilt, and cloud-native deployment practices
Event-driven architectures and reconciliation systems
AI Engineering & Agentic Development: Prompt Engineering, Context Engineering, Custom Skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Tool/Function Calling, Agentic Workflows, RAG, AI-assisted Code Generation, Automated Test Generation, Intelligent Code Review, AI-powered Debugging & Refactoring
positions.insights: Skills: Claude Code · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Docker: Accelerated Container Application Development · Tilt-up · AI-First Developer

positions.title: Sr. FullStack .Net Reactjs Web Developer
positions.description:
In my role, I have actively contributed to the development and support of Admin Portal Pages and Web APIs, where I had the opportunity to create a Dashboard and Calculator page from scratch using .Net technologies. As part of this process, I worked on the UI implementation using ReactJS as the front-end technology.

Operating within an Agile methodology, I embraced short Product Backlog Item (PBI) cycles and participated in daily Scrum meetings to ensure efficient project progress. Throughout the development lifecycle, I prioritized code quality and collaboration by utilizing GIT and GitHub for code reviews, following a Pull Request workflow. Additionally, Rally served as our Agile Project Management Tool, enabling effective project coordination and tracking.

The development environment in which I worked encompassed a range of technologies and tools. These included Web API, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, GIT, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MS SQL, NestJS, Visual Studio Code, npm, nvm, Angular, ReactJS, NodeJS, DBeaver, and Cloud Foundry.

In terms of skills, I possess expertise in AngularJS, Python, NestJS, .NET Core, and the .NET Framework. These skills have proven valuable in delivering high-quality solutions and driving successful project outcomes.

By leveraging my proficiency in these technologies and my commitment to collaboration and agile practices, I have consistently contributed to the development of robust and efficient Admin Portal Pages and Web APIs. I am excited to continue applying my skills and expertise to future projects, driving innovation and delivering exceptional results.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Python (Programming Language) · NestJS · .NET Core · AngularJS

positions.title: Sr. FullStack .Net Web Developer
positions.description:
I have successfully contributed to various technical interviews and internal projects with a focus on responsive design in the .Net, Angular, and ReactJS frameworks. In these roles, I played a key part in the development and support of Customer and Admin Portal Pages, as well as Web APIs.

Utilizing standard Microsoft technologies, I employed React as the primary front-end technology to deliver engaging and user-friendly UI experiences. I embraced the Agile methodology, actively participating in short Product Backlog Item (PBI) cycles and engaging in daily Scrum meetings. Throughout these projects, I also collaborated on creating and implementing comprehensive Unit Test scenarios to ensure high-quality and robust solutions.

To maintain code quality and collaboration, I introduced a streamlined code review process using Pull Requests via GIT and Azure DevOps Repos. This approach facilitated efficient and effective code reviews, leading to timely identification and resolution of any issues. Furthermore, I utilized Azure DevOps Pipelines for seamless continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), optimizing the development and release workflows.

The technologies I proficiently worked with include Web API, C#, HTML, CSS, GIT, SQL Server, JavaScript, React, .Net Core, Azure DevOps, Entity Framework, Visual Studio Professional, Visual Studio Code, NuGet, Angular, Rest, NodeJS, SQL Server Management Studio, and MongoDB.

By leveraging these skills and technologies, I consistently delivered successful outcomes in my projects. I am eager to contribute my expertise and collaborate on future endeavors in a dynamic and innovative environment.

positions.title: Sr. FullStack .Net Web Developer
positions.description:
I worked on developing the Customer Analytic Page and Web API using Microsoft technologies. This involved creating the user interface from scratch using Angular 8, with a mock serving as a reference. Throughout the project, we followed the Agile methodology, with short Product Backlog Items (PBI), daily Scrum meetings, and implementation of BDD Unit Test scenarios.

To ensure code quality, we conducted code reviews through Pull Requests using GIT and Azure DevOps Repos. The technology stack included .Net Core, Angular, C#, TypeScript, CSS, HTML, and SQL Server. We utilized tools such as GIT, Azure DevOps, and Visual Studio for seamless collaboration. This experience provided me with hands-on experience in working with SCRUM/Agile methodologies and enhanced my skills in both frontend and backend development.

positions.title: Software Engineer and Consultant
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer at Check into Cash, I actively participated in the SCRUM process, focusing on web applications and internal tools. My responsibilities included supporting and implementing features in the company's web applications. Throughout this role, I utilized a range of technologies such as .Net Core, Angular, TFS, Bootstrap, SQL Server, HTML, and CSS. Additionally, I worked on developing and executing Unit Tests for both Angular and .Net Core, ensuring the reliability and quality of the applications.

TopShelf Training Platform:
At TopShelf, I contributed to the development of a training platform for our client. Using Angular as our core technology, I played a key role in designing and creating new components, controllers, and database tables from scratch. This involved deploying new features and enhancing the platform's functionality. By working on this project, I gained valuable experience in Angular development and database design.

Becton, Dickinson and Company:
In my role at Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD) in San Diego, CA, I provided support and performed upgrades on their applications. This involved working with various programming languages such as C++, C#, and VB6. I successfully upgraded applications to be compatible with Visual Studio 2017 and configured the product for the United States Department of Defense (DoD). Throughout this project, I collaborated with different virtual machines and applications, ensuring seamless communication between them. Currently, I am still actively working on new implementations for the client.

positions.title: Software Engineer Project Lead
positions.description: Responsible for the project and development team for the implementation of a sales panel using Acumatica as ERP and Web service, using as development technologies; PHP(CakePHP as MVC), Linux Server, Windows Server, MS SQL , MySQL, SOAP, HTML5, CSS3, JS, Bootstrap, Magento and GIT as version control. And additional developments as custom android applications.

positions.title: VB, C++ & C#  Developer
positions.description:
Support developer to General Electric’s softwares, Debugging and fixing up software, migrations of old softwares using VB6 and C++ 6 , develop new solutions in C# to obtain information from the MS SQL database or update it.
For example: updating an application made in VB6 you had to remove the report module using Crystal Report and implement a free solution.
Also the migration of an application made in C ++ that had to be recompiled for the new version of windows server.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer (E-commerce)
positions.description:
Developing and debugging of the E-shop sites corresponding to each carrier in Latin America, including billing, transactions, notifications, SMS and Web services.
For example: To update prices of products with respect to the telefonic carrier, creation of new promotions as well as new portals depending on the country and the telefonic carrier, Php script update, from one version to another to avoid fatals in the system.

positions.title: C++, C# Video Game Developer
positions.description:
Game programmer for platforms, iOS, android and windows phone. Working in Dungeon Hunter 5 project in the area of porting to windows phone.
For example: Analyze and debug the game to find the origin of certain reported failures, as well as implement new configurations of languages and bridge modules between C # and C ++

https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/store/apps/dungeon-hunter-5/9nblggh0m1n0

positions.description: Internship in the area of IT incidents responsible for checking the tickets for the area of Level 2 and developer of applications in C # and VBA.
